technical-summary: libr3 gfx1100: the narrow 8-bit GEMM (gemm_i8a8_nt_m16 / fp8a8) keeps the token guard always and decides the unguarded Full form from N and K only, so 17-31 token rows no longer run the fully guarded kernel. Kernel M 17-31 = M 32 cost (-10 to -23%); engine decode-only +9.9/+11.3/+8.2% at 5/6/7 streams on qwen27b-tp3-int8-556-long, 1 stream -0.9%; KLD identical, stress 12/12.
user-summary-candidate: Decoding 5 to 7 conversations at once on the three-card int8 setup is 8-11% faster: the 6-stream dip is gone, with output unchanged.
